method.matrix: last decoder layer, head mean; raw saved values
method.secondary_path: local first parent independently per step
method.pairs: all six unordered pairs of four queries, for all 32 fixed users
method.positions: all encoder positions with actual encoder_mask == 1, including visible special tokens
method.cosine_and_pearson: raw visible weights; Pearson is null for a constant row
method.TV_and_JS: visible rows divided by their visible sum only to form probability distributions; TV=0.5*L1, JS=0.5*(KL(p||m)+KL(q||m)), natural log
method.figure_preprocessing: none; no row rescaling, clipping or image alteration
method.worst_case_rule: lowest per-user mean of six pair cosines; tie by sample key; all users retained
method.cross_condition_matrix_comparison: not performed; no unaligned Shuffle-column comparison
